name: io.github.phalkmin/trendzeist-mcp
title: Trendzeist – Google Trends for content ideation
description: Free, local Google Trends MCP: ranked breakout/rising/evergreen topics, interest over time, related queries, regions, real-time trends. No API key or browser.

environmentVariables.name: TRENDZEIST_HL
environmentVariables.description: Google Trends UI language, e.g. en-US or pt-BR.

environmentVariables.name: TRENDZEIST_MIN_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Minimum seconds between requests to Google (rate-limit protection).

environmentVariables.name: TRENDZEIST_PROXIES
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated proxy URLs for rotation.
